# Creative Enzymes

> Creative Enzymes specializes in enzyme products and molecular biology reagents for diagnostic kit development, clinical chemistry, and PCR-based molecular analysis.

The company offers a comprehensive catalog of diagnostic-grade enzymes, assay kits, and molecular biology tools including PCR kits, DNA markers, and clinical chemistry reagents for in-vitro diagnostic (IVD) applications and research use.

## Key Topics

- Restriction Enzymes
- DNA Modifying Enzymes
- PCR Kits
- Cloning Enzymes
- SuperCut Series
- Diagnostic Kits
- Clinical Chemistry
- Assay Development
- in-vitro diagnostic (IVD)
- DNA Extraction
- Molecular Biology
- Enzyme Products
- Blood PCR Kit
- Animal Tissue PCR Kit
- Guanidinase

## Diagnostic Kits & Assays

- [Enzymes for Diagnostic Kit Development](https://diagnostic-enzymes.creative-enzymes.com/products/diagnostic-kits.html): Diagnostic-grade enzymes for clinical chemistry and assay kit development

## PCR Kits & Molecular Tools

- [Animal Tissue PCR Kit](https://molecular-tools.creative-enzymes.com/animal-tissue-pcr-kit-item-264.html): Animal Tissue PCR Kit for molecular biology DNA extraction and amplification
- [Blood PCR Kit](https://molecular-tools.creative-enzymes.com/blood-pcr-kit-item-265.html): Blood PCR Kit for whole-blood DNA amplification and molecular analysis
- [0.7kb DNA Marker](https://molecular-tools.creative-enzymes.com/07kb-dna-marker-item-230.html): 0.7kb DNA Marker (MK-2004) for gel electrophoresis and molecular analysis
